title: Dortai

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 70b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.70b.5): Yehudah ben Dortai. Yehudah also had a son named Dortai; Hyman places them in Hillel’s time, and says that he went with his father and settled in the South.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Hebrew says that Yehudah and his son withdrew together and then uses a singular verb for settling in the South. Hyman takes the son as the one accompanying his father.
The baraita names Shemayah and Avtalyon. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1627&lang=en) places the episode in their time. Hyman places the family in Hillel’s time.
